skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental concepts of state and law, including the nature of the state, the structure and functions of state institutions, and the basic principles of law and legal systems.
Apply knowledge to identify the authority of state institutions in legislative and enforcement activities, recognize basic legal violations, and understand the legal consequences for violators.
Demonstrate the ability to adhere to rules and regulations, and understand personal responsibilities within legal frameworks.
Conduct research on legal topics, including the ability to identify and analyze legal sources and documents.
Effectively communicate legal concepts and findings through presentations and discussions.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze legal issues and make informed decisions.
